upstream.description: Secure, Fast, and Extensible Sandbox runtime for AI agents.

classification.analysis: OpenSandbox is a general-purpose sandbox runtime for AI applications, providing multi-language SDKs (Python, Java/Kotlin, TypeScript, C#, Go), a CLI (osb), and an MCP server for creating isolated sandboxes and running commands, file I/O, and code execution. It runs on Docker or Kubernetes with strong-isolation runtimes like gVisor, Kata, and Firecracker, a credential vault for safe outbound secrets, and an ingress/egress network policy layer, targeting teams that need to safely execute untrusted code from coding agents, browser-automation agents, or RL training loops at scale. Backed by Alibaba and listed in the CNCF landscape, with examples for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, LangGraph, and Playwright sandboxes.

use_cases.title: Run untrusted AI-agent-generated code in an isolated sandbox
Give a coding agent like Claude Code a disposable sandbox via MCP
Scale sandbox workloads on Kubernetes for RL training or evaluation
